name: Calaveras Reservoir - Waterscape

crop.note: Scene metres from terrain.json's UTM origin (x east, z south) for the north-west corner, and the size in blocks. Covers the whole shoreline and the three browser viewpoints.

metresPerBlockNote: 4 m on all three axes keeps true proportions (Hetch Hetchy uses 2 m horizontally, 4 m vertically). A maintainer decision; see docs/roadmap/tasks/MC2-calaveras.md.

dam.name: Calaveras Dam
dam.note: Crest line traced by hand on the 1 m NAIP image (372 m against NID's 1,210 ft); crest elevation is the 3DEP maximum along it (flat at 237.4 m over most of its length). The 10 m bundle grid already holds the embankment as a smooth hill; the builder levels the crest and dresses the faces. Spillway centre line, chute width (about 22 m) and stilling basin traced on the same image; the spillway is drawn dry. Crest width is an estimate. Illustrative, not as-built drawings.
